description:
Create an AI-generated image from a text description, optionally guided by a reference image.

WORKFLOW:
1. Call this tool with your prompt → returns task_id immediately
2. Wait ~15 seconds, then call check_kling_task(task_id, task_type="image")
3. Repeat step 2 until status is "succeed" — the response then includes image URL(s)

REFERENCE IMAGE (optional): guide the generation with an existing image, EITHER as a public HTTPS URL (image_url) OR a local file (image_path, inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH or the system temp directory; .jpg / .jpeg / .png, max 10MB).

MODELS (newest to oldest): kling-v2-1 (default), kling-v2, kling-v1-5, kling-v1.

callback_url.description: HTTPS URL that Kling POSTs the task result to when the task status changes. Optional — polling with check_kling_task works without it.

image_path.description: Absolute path to a local reference image inside MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH (or the system temp directory). Formats: .jpg / .jpeg / .png, max 10MB. Provide either image_url or image_path, not both.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a reference image. Provide either image_url or image_path, not both.

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-9). Default: 1

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid: "blurry, distorted faces, text, watermark, low quality"

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image: subject, setting, style, lighting, mood. Max 2500 chars.

name: generate_kling_image
